summary: This is a configuration file that sets up environment variables for a Docker container running a Python application. It defines the app directory location, container name, user/group IDs for the Linux user inside the container, the username to create, and which Python version to use.

explanations.8: This sets the numeric group ID (like a team identifier in Linux) to 1000, which is typically the first non-root user group in a Linux system.
explanations.11: This sets the numeric user ID to 1000, which identifies the user account that will run processes inside the container (separate from the host machine's user IDs).
explanations.14: The OS username is set to 'python' — this is the actual login name of the user account that will be created inside the container with the ID specified above.
explanations.17: This specifies to use Python version 3.13 with the 'slim' variant, which is a lightweight Docker image that includes Python but excludes unnecessary extra packages.
